entries.40c7323891c5e1f6: Centered on the 'Matsumotokiyoshi' banner, this business operates chains of drugstores and insurance-dispensing pharmacies, and also opens and runs insurance-dispensing pharmacies, develops franchise operations and supplies products to franchisees. The core company is Matsumotokiyoshi Co., Ltd., and it includes regional sales companies (East Japan, Koshinetsu, Chugoku-Shikoku and Kyushu) and Papasumo Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥711,030 million (up 6.6% year on year), the largest of the four reportable segments. The company explains that cosmetics led strong sales, as it captured increased foot traffic in urban areas, downtown districts and commercial facilities, and demand from inbound foreign tourists. As of March 31, 2026, the number of domestic stores was 1,970 (of which 481 were dispensing pharmacies), and 313 stores were members of the 'Dispensing Support Program' that supports pharmacy management. Overseas stores total 100: 37 in Thailand, 23 in Taiwan, 20 in Vietnam, 18 in Hong Kong, 1 in Guam and 1 in Malaysia. Leveraging 169,550,000 customer touchpoints, it is advancing efforts to combine stores with its app and online store.
entries.45e2b5d0ede81b19: In April 2012, it transferred the sales business in the Kyushu region of Matsumoto Kiyoshi Co., Ltd. to Midori Yakuhin Co., Ltd. and changed its name to "Matsumoto Kiyoshi Kyushu Sales Co., Ltd." In the same month, it also changed the name of Higashinihon Sales to "Matsumoto Kiyoshi Higashinihon Sales Co., Ltd." and established Matsumoto Kiyoshi Pharmacies Co., Ltd. to expand the dispensing business. In October of the same year, it transferred the sales business in the Chushikoku region to Matsumoto Kiyoshi Chushikoku Sales Co., Ltd. through an incorporation-type company split. In April 2013, it established Matsumoto Kiyoshi Wholesale Co., Ltd. as an intermediate holding company to operate the wholesale business flexibly and centralize management resources.

entries.4a7494d9de6ad892: This business procures and sells products handled by group companies, manages and oversees group companies, and undertakes indirect operations on consignment. It also includes planning and development of private-brand products, asset management and operation, store construction and maintenance, temp staffing and placement services, and sales agency for life and non-life insurance. The core company is MCC Management Co., Ltd., and the holding company itself (headquartered in Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo) also belongs to this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,534 million (down 4.2% year on year), but revenue including internal revenue from group companies was ¥683,585 million. The company explains that it also supplies products externally, undertakes construction work and advertising, and that the scope of its operations is expanding. It has the smallest external-customer revenue of the reportable segments, and most of its revenue comes from transactions within the group.
